openers: I read every contract twice, and this shirt explains why.

I don't sign anything until I see the fine print.
Show me the snacks first, then we'll talk.
My friends say I'm too skeptical, so I wore the proof.

Snacks first, decisions later, that's my rule.
I ask a lot of questions, and this shirt gets it.

I'm the friend who always checks the receipt.
This is the most honest shirt I own.
details: The tall white condensed letters are super crisp, and the VAN line is printed bigger so it hits right away.
That golden-yellow slab-serif I'M NOT STUPID at the bottom is the punchline, and it really pops on the black.
The print sits perfectly centered and stays sharp even after a bunch of washes.
It's a soft, heavyweight black cotton that fits relaxed without being boxy.
The bigger VAN line makes people slow down and read the whole thing.
It's the perfect gag gift for the friend who questions everything.
The white lettering against the black cotton is so clean and readable from across the room.
That yellow slab-serif last line gives it a bold, vintage poster vibe.
It's super soft, breathable, and holds its shape all day.
The stacked layout reads like a punchline, and the yellow finish lands it.
I've gotten more laughs from this shirt than from my actual jokes.
Great fit, thick fabric, and a print that doesn't crack or fade.
